text: Equipment in zones shall be certified (Ex d, Ex e, Ex i, Ex p, Ex n as appropriate, with at least IIB + H2 (or IIC in hydrogen zones) and T3 minimum unless a lower temperature class is required by the substances); the minimum category is 2G for zone 1 and 3G for zone 2; outdoor equipment shall be IP66 in stainless steel or with a marine coating (C5); no non-Ex electrical equipment shall be installed in a classified zone; the electrical installation shall be per IEC 60079-14 and inspected per IEC 60079-17.
